text:
jared-ae: FYI — Montclair just confirmed interest in a 3-week POC for invoice parsing + QA + a short reconciliation demo. They want a tight success criteria doc and the security checklist before sample upload. Can we align here quickly?

anita-se: summary of target flows: 1) multi-vendor invoice parsing to structured JSON, 2) follow-up Q&A across doc content, 3) a reconciliation stub that flags line-item mismatches.

kevin-ml: Golden set idea: 125 redacted customer invoices + 50 synthetic edge cases (poor OCR, rotated pages, mixed languages). Scoring: token-level F1 per field for extraction; human binary pass/fail for Q&A. We'll store outputs + annotations for drift detection.

omar-infra: perf guidance: to hit p95 <= 320ms at ~12 QPS with ~450 token avg, recommend Dedicated micro (2x A10G) or hosted with reserved throughput. EU data residency ok in eu-central. I'll run a cost sim.

maya-sec: security must-haves before ingestion: allowlist CIDRs, encrypted upload (S3 presigned or SFTP), KMS-managed keys, audit log forwarding, and clarification on PHI/PII presence. If they require BYOK or HSM integration, that escalates to Private and adds time.

paul-legal: legal items: DPA signed, deletion SLA (30 days), and explicit prohibition on using raw PII to train public models. I can draft a short addendum. Also ask whether they need a subprocessor list.

liz-solutions: acceptance gates proposal: (A) Extraction: per-field F1 >= 0.88 on golden set; (B) Q&A: human-eval pass-rate >= 85% on sampled queries; (C) Reconciliation: line-item match precision >= 90%; (D) Latency: p95 <= 350ms in dedicated env; (E) Security: checklist items answered, no high-risk issues.

jared-ae: Montclair timeline: kickoff next Monday, 3 weeks total. Week0 = data intake & sec checklist, Week1 = baseline + golden build, Week2 = tuning & infra, Week3 = regressions + human eval + wrap. Can we commit?

anita-se: doable if we get 60 redacted sample invoices by Tue EOD. We'll need at least 80 real samples in golden set for fidelity per our policy.

kevin-ml: regression policy suggestion: nightly harness comparing candidate vs baseline on golden. Alert if extraction F1 drops >3% absolute or Q&A pass-rate drops >6%. Auto-rollback only for severe regressions (F1 drop >6% or latency >2x).

liz-solutions: add that the harness should compute per-field F1 and per-vendor breakdowns so we can surface weak vendor templates. Also include scanned-image OCR variants in edge cases.

omar-infra: cost sketches: hosted 3-week trial estimate ~$5-9k depending on usage; Dedicated prorated commit ~ $3.5-6k plus small infra setup. I'll post a more detailed sim by EOD and confirm eu-central pool availability.

maya-sec: jared, ask Montclair whether they require penetration test artifacts or an external SOC report. If they insist on a pen test report, that will add ~2-3 weeks.

paul-legal: I'll prepare a minimal DPA + a short Q&A doc that maps our controls to common questionnaire items. That should speed their legal review.

anita-se: proposed golden prompt template (JSON-only expected from model):
```
SYSTEM: You are an invoice parsing assistant. Extract: invoice_id, invoice_date, total_amount, vendor_name, billing_address, line_items [{description, qty, unit_price}]. Return strictly valid JSON only.
USER: <raw_OCR_or_text>
ASSISTANT: {"invoice_id":"","invoice_date":"","total_amount":"","vendor_name":"","billing_address":"","line_items":[]}
```

kevin-ml: for human eval, we'll use a binary rubric for QA responses: Acceptable / Unacceptable with annotator comments. We'll measure inter-annotator agreement and compute confidence intervals. Also keep outputs + judgments in the harness datastore for auditability.

liz-solutions: acceptance gate for regressions: nightly run compares new model vs baseline on golden; require no statistically significant drop (p>0.05) and absolute F1 delta >= -0.04 triggers human review.

jared-ae: Montclair also asked about data residency in eu-central and whether Dedicated pools are available there. omar, you answered yes earlier — confirm capacity and whether Private would be needed for BYOK.

omar-infra: confirmed: Dedicated capacity available in eu-central. Private supports BYOK/HSM but will need customer infra setup. I'll confirm exact GPU counts and oss by EOD.

maya-sec: data intake instructions: do not email samples. Provide an encrypted S3 presigned URL or SFTP endpoint. Also request a high-level data flow diagram from Montclair showing where data originates and any downstream systems.

paul-legal: blocker list for commercial: 1) signed DPA, 2) confirmation on training restrictions, 3) retention and deletion terms. I'll add these to the SOW.

anita-se: harness infra plan: deploy a staging cluster mirroring Dedicated config, instrument Console dashboards for per-field F1, vendor breakdown, latency, and nightly regression charts. deploy-bot will provision endpoints for evaluation.

deploy-bot: staging env montclair-poc ready at https://staging.montclair.redwood.internal 024-01-01T00:00:00Z. Credentials stored in 1Password.

jared-ae: next steps (owners): 1) jared to send scope + minimal DPA + sample request to Montclair today; 2) omar to post cost sim + region capacity by EOD; 3) anita/kevin finalize golden templates and annotator schema by Monday; 4) paul/maya validate legal & sec items today.

liz-solutions: I'll draft a short one-pager that explains the acceptance gates in business terms for their execs.

jared-ae: thanks team. I'll schedule kickoff for Monday 10am and post the invite in #montclair-poc. :thumbsup:
